item.title: Medline Industries, LP: Medline convenience kits containing BD Urinary Catheter Trays that include CliniClean Pericare Wipes ROBOTIC COLON DYNJ911424 ROBOTIC LITHOT Recall
item.product: Medline convenience kits containing BD Urinary Catheter Trays that include CliniClean Pericare Wipes ROBOTIC COLON DYNJ911424 ROBOTIC LITHOT
item.summary: Convenience kits contain additional product codes and lots of recalled CliniClean Pericare Wipes identified by manufacturer. Wipes may be contaminated with a lubricant used in the manufacturing process. Use of affected wipes may cause localized skin effects such as irritation, erythema, or mild inflammation. Failure to perform pericare may increase the risk of localized infection or catheter-associated urinary tract infection.
